task: Harden the three `systemctl restart docker` calls in .github/workflows/e2e-airgap.yaml against docker.service's start limit: reset-failed before the restart, one retry after 5 s, journal dump and failure if the retry also fails.

events.summary: Only the host-tool setup steps of the three jobs in .github/workflows/e2e-airgap.yaml and this trace change. Not touched: scripts, Go code, charts, action pins, allowed endpoints.

Two Air-Gap E2E jobs on 2026-11-24 failed before the E2E started with 'Job for docker.service failed because start of the service was attempted too often': the ext4 leg of run 45483093957 attempt 1 and the btrfs leg of run 45488055966 attempt 1 (Azure runners). Both passed on rerun. Not reproduced locally; the systemd start-limit cause is an inference from the message.

Each restart is now preceded by `systemctl reset-failed docker.service`, retried once after 5 s with another reset-failed, and on a second failure prints `journalctl -u docker.service -n 80` and exits 1, so a recurrence fails with its own diagnosis.
Static checks only: actionlint rc=0 on the workflow, YAML parses, three identical replacements. The retry path cannot be forced on a hosted runner; the PR's CI run proves the normal path still works.
events.scope: Workflow text; no runtime confirmation of the retry branch.
